01_portfolio:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: exactly one row per borrower before portfolio aggregation.
-- The ROW_NUMBER guard makes duplicate borrower rows visible and prevents silent double counting.
WITH ranked_features AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        exposure,
        utilization,
        debt_service_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM borrower_features
),
borrower_grain AS (
    SELECT borrower_id, exposure, utilization, debt_service_ratio
    FROM ranked_features
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
    ROUND(SUM(exposure), 2) AS exposure_egp,
    ROUND(AVG(utilization), 4) AS mean_utilization,
    ROUND(AVG(debt_service_ratio), 4) AS mean_debt_service_ratio
FROM borrower_grain;
02_delinquency_trend:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: one account-month row before monthly aggregation.
-- Historical cutoff is enforced before aggregation so future outcome rows cannot leak into the trend.
WITH ranked_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        month_end,
        balance,
        dpd,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id, month_end
            ORDER BY account_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM monthly_snapshots
    WHERE month_end <= '2025-12-31'
),
account_month AS (
    SELECT account_id, month_end, balance, dpd
    FROM ranked_snapshots
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    month_end,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dpd >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_accounts,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dpd >= 30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 5) AS late_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(balance), 2) AS exposure_egp
FROM account_month
GROUP BY month_end
ORDER BY month_end;
03_utilization_segments:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: both feature and outcome inputs are reduced to borrower grain before joining.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        exposure,
        utilization,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
    FROM borrower_features
),
outcome_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        bad_6m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
    FROM borrower_outcomes
),
borrower_base AS (
    SELECT
        f.borrower_id,
        f.exposure,
        f.utilization,
        o.bad_6m
    FROM feature_ranked f
    JOIN outcome_ranked o
      ON o.borrower_id = f.borrower_id
     AND o.rn = 1
    WHERE f.rn = 1
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        exposure,
        bad_6m,
        CASE
            WHEN utilization < 0.3 THEN '01 Under 30%'
            WHEN utilization < 0.6 THEN '02 30-60%'
            WHEN utilization < 0.9 THEN '03 60-90%'
            ELSE '04 90% or more'
        END AS segment
    FROM borrower_base
)
SELECT
    segment,
    COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
    SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
    ROUND(AVG(bad_6m), 5) AS observed_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(exposure), 2) AS exposure_egp
FROM segmented
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment;
04_roll_rates:
-- ACCOUNT-MONTH PIPELINE:
-- 1) enforce historical cutoff, 2) deduplicate account-month grain,
-- 3) derive delinquency bands, 4) calculate adjacent transitions only within each account.
WITH snapshot_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        month_end,
        dpd,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id, month_end
            ORDER BY account_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM monthly_snapshots
    WHERE month_end <= '2025-12-31'
),
account_month AS (
    SELECT account_id, month_end, dpd
    FROM snapshot_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
bands AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        month_end,
        CASE
            WHEN dpd = 0 THEN 'Current'
            WHEN dpd < 30 THEN '01-29'
            WHEN dpd < 60 THEN '30-59'
            ELSE '60+'
        END AS band
    FROM account_month
),
transitions AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        month_end,
        band,
        LAG(band) OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id
            ORDER BY month_end
        ) AS previous_band
    FROM bands
),
transition_counts AS (
    SELECT
        previous_band,
        band,
        COUNT(*) AS transitions
    FROM transitions
    WHERE previous_band IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY previous_band, band
)
SELECT
    previous_band,
    band,
    transitions,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * transitions
        / NULLIF(SUM(transitions) OVER (PARTITION BY previous_band), 0),
        5
    ) AS transition_rate
FROM transition_counts
ORDER BY previous_band, band;
05_test_deciles:
-- EVALUATION GRAIN: one prediction per test borrower before ranking.
-- Stable borrower_id tie-break avoids nondeterministic NTILE assignment.
WITH prediction_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        pd,
        bad_6m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY split, borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM predictions
    WHERE split = 'test'
),
test_base AS (
    SELECT borrower_id, pd, bad_6m
    FROM prediction_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        pd,
        bad_6m,
        NTILE(10) OVER (
            ORDER BY pd DESC, borrower_id
        ) AS risk_decile
    FROM test_base
)
SELECT
    risk_decile,
    COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
    SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
    ROUND(AVG(pd), 5) AS predicted_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(bad_6m), 5) AS observed_rate
FROM ranked
GROUP BY risk_decile
ORDER BY risk_decile;
06_test_calibration:
-- One row per held-out borrower before fixed-width probability binning.
WITH prediction_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        pd,
        bad_6m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY split, borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM predictions
    WHERE split = 'test'
),
test_base AS (
    SELECT borrower_id, pd, bad_6m
    FROM prediction_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
binned AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        pd,
        bad_6m,
        MIN(9, CAST(pd * 10 AS INTEGER)) AS probability_bin
    FROM test_base
)
SELECT
    probability_bin,
    COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
    ROUND(AVG(pd), 5) AS predicted_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(bad_6m), 5) AS observed_rate
FROM binned
GROUP BY probability_bin
ORDER BY probability_bin;
07_product_mix:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: reduce snapshots to the selected month and one row per account
-- before joining to the account dimension.
WITH account_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        product,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id
            ORDER BY account_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM accounts
),
snapshot_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        month_end,
        balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id, month_end
            ORDER BY account_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM monthly_snapshots
    WHERE month_end = '2025-12-31'
),
month_end_balance AS (
    SELECT account_id, balance
    FROM snapshot_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
account_dim AS (
    SELECT account_id, product
    FROM account_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    a.product,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts,
    ROUND(SUM(m.balance), 2) AS exposure_egp
FROM account_dim a
JOIN month_end_balance m
  ON m.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY a.product
ORDER BY a.product;
08_history_segments:
-- Borrower-grain join with explicit duplicate guards on both sides.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        history_months,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
    FROM borrower_features
),
outcome_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        bad_6m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
    FROM borrower_outcomes
),
borrower_base AS (
    SELECT
        f.borrower_id,
        f.history_months,
        o.bad_6m
    FROM feature_ranked f
    JOIN outcome_ranked o
      ON o.borrower_id = f.borrower_id
     AND o.rn = 1
    WHERE f.rn = 1
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        bad_6m,
        CASE
            WHEN history_months < 36 THEN '01 12-35 months'
            WHEN history_months < 84 THEN '02 36-83 months'
            ELSE '03 84+ months'
        END AS segment
    FROM borrower_base
)
SELECT
    segment,
    COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
    SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
    ROUND(AVG(bad_6m), 5) AS observed_rate
FROM segmented
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment;
09_analytical_mart:
-- MART CONTRACT: exactly one final row per synthetic borrower.
-- Each source is independently reduced to its intended grain before joins to prevent fan-out.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM borrower_features f
),
prediction_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        split,
        pd,
        bad_6m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM predictions
),
product_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product) > 1 THEN 'Mixed products'
            WHEN MIN(product) = 'card' THEN 'Card only'
            ELSE 'Personal only'
        END AS product_group
    FROM accounts
    GROUP BY borrower_id
),
mart AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        p.split,
        p.pd,
        p.bad_6m,
        pr.product_group
    FROM feature_ranked f
    JOIN prediction_ranked p
      ON p.borrower_id = f.borrower_id
     AND p.rn = 1
    JOIN product_rollup pr
      ON pr.borrower_id = f.borrower_id
    WHERE f.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM mart
ORDER BY borrower_id;
10_threshold_sweep:
-- HELD-OUT TEST ONLY.
-- Deduplicate borrower predictions first, then CROSS JOIN the threshold spine.
WITH RECURSIVE thresholds(t) AS (
    SELECT 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t + 5
    FROM thresholds
    WHERE t < 100
),
prediction_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        pd,
        bad_6m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY split, borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM predictions
    WHERE split = 'test'
),
test_base AS (
    SELECT borrower_id, pd, bad_6m
    FROM prediction_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    t / 100.0 AS threshold,
    COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
    SUM(pd >= t / 100.0 AND bad_6m = 1) AS true_positive,
    SUM(pd >= t / 100.0 AND bad_6m = 0) AS false_positive,
    SUM(pd <  t / 100.0 AND bad_6m = 1) AS false_negative,
    SUM(pd <  t / 100.0 AND bad_6m = 0) AS true_negative,
    1.0 * SUM(pd >= t / 100.0 AND bad_6m = 1)
        / NULLIF(SUM(pd >= t / 100.0), 0) AS precision,
    1.0 * SUM(pd >= t / 100.0 AND bad_6m = 1)
        / NULLIF(SUM(bad_6m), 0) AS recall
FROM thresholds
CROSS JOIN test_base
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t;
11_probability_distribution:
-- Complete split/bin spine keeps empty bins visible.
-- One prediction per borrower/split is enforced before the LEFT JOIN.
WITH RECURSIVE bins(b) AS (
    SELECT 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b + 1 FROM bins WHERE b < 9
),
splits(s) AS (
    SELECT 'train'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'validation'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'test'
),
prediction_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        split,
        pd,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY split, borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM predictions
),
prediction_base AS (
    SELECT borrower_id, split, pd
    FROM prediction_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    s AS split,
    b AS bin,
    b / 10.0 AS lower_bound,
    (b + 1) / 10.0 AS upper_bound,
    COUNT(p.borrower_id) AS borrowers
FROM splits
CROSS JOIN bins
LEFT JOIN prediction_base p
  ON p.split = s
 AND MIN(9, CAST(p.pd * 10 AS INTEGER)) = b
GROUP BY s, b
ORDER BY s, b;
12_exposure_by_risk:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: borrower prediction and feature tables are independently deduplicated.
WITH prediction_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        split,
        pd,
        bad_6m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY split, borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM predictions
),
feature_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        exposure,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM borrower_features
),
borrower_base AS (
    SELECT
        p.borrower_id,
        p.split,
        p.pd,
        p.bad_6m,
        f.exposure
    FROM prediction_ranked p
    JOIN feature_ranked f
      ON f.borrower_id = p.borrower_id
     AND f.rn = 1
    WHERE p.rn = 1
),
banded AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN pd < .1 THEN '00-10%'
            WHEN pd < .2 THEN '10-20%'
            WHEN pd < .3 THEN '20-30%'
            WHEN pd < .5 THEN '30-50%'
            ELSE '50-100%'
        END AS probability_band
    FROM borrower_base
)
SELECT
    split,
    probability_band,
    COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
    ROUND(SUM(exposure), 2) AS exposure_egp,
    AVG(pd) AS mean_probability,
    AVG(bad_6m) AS observed_event_rate
FROM banded
GROUP BY split, probability_band
ORDER BY split, probability_band;
13_monthly_quality:
-- SOURCE-GRAIN CONTROL REPORT.
-- Do not deduplicate here: this report is deliberately intended to expose source defects.
WITH source_rows AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        month_end,
        balance,
        payment_due,
        payment_paid,
        dpd,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id, month_end
            ORDER BY account_id
        ) AS duplicate_rank
    FROM monthly_snapshots
)
SELECT
    month_end,
    COUNT(*) AS account_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS unique_accounts,
    SUM(
        balance IS NULL
        OR payment_due IS NULL
        OR payment_paid IS NULL
        OR dpd IS NULL
    ) AS null_rows,
    SUM(
        payment_paid > payment_due
        OR payment_paid < 0
        OR balance < 0
    ) AS invalid_amount_rows,
    SUM(dpd < 0 OR dpd > 180) AS invalid_dpd_rows
FROM source_rows
GROUP BY month_end
ORDER BY month_end;
14_training_woe_counts:
-- TRAINING-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC.
-- Deduplicate both inputs before joining so event/non-event counts remain borrower-grain.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        utilization,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM borrower_features
),
prediction_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        split,
        bad_6m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY split, borrower_id
            ORDER BY borrower_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM predictions
    WHERE split = 'train'
),
train_base AS (
    SELECT
        f.borrower_id,
        f.utilization,
        p.bad_6m
    FROM feature_ranked f
    JOIN prediction_ranked p
      ON p.borrower_id = f.borrower_id
     AND p.rn = 1
    WHERE f.rn = 1
),
binned AS (
    SELECT
        borrower_id,
        bad_6m,
        MIN(4, CAST(utilization * 5 AS INTEGER)) AS utilization_bin
    FROM train_base
)
SELECT
    utilization_bin,
    COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
    SUM(bad_6m = 0) AS non_events,
    SUM(bad_6m = 1) AS events
FROM binned
GROUP BY utilization_bin
ORDER BY utilization_bin;
